punchline: In Tribal Leadership, the person at stage three keeps others apart so they never compare notes.
thirty_sec: Tribal Leadership says a leader works on two things: the words people use and the relationships they form. At stage three, everything runs in pairs through one person who keeps others apart. The fix is to ask what people value, then give them a project too big for one person. Relationships form in threes around a shared value, and people start saying 'we'.
